article.title: The effect of cognitive behavioral therapy for sleep and glycemic outcomes in people with diabetes: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
article.authors: Jiao Y, He X, Ma L
article.abstract: Sleep disturbances are highly prevalent in individuals with diabetes and are associated with various adverse physiological, psychological, and social consequences. A growing body of research supports the effectiveness of cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) in managing sleep problems in diabetes. However, the extent of its positive correlation with sleep quality and glycemic outcomes remains unclear due to the lack of rigorous evidence synthesis.
